BWHP107 is the standardized Danish procedure code designating treatment with upadacitinib, a Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system's tracking of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) therapies, this code is utilized to monitor the administration of the drug across different patient demographics [^src1]. 

According to the DANIBD 2025 report, BWHP107 is classified under the broader therapeutic category of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biological and targeted synthetic drugs) [^src1]. Clinical data recorded under this specific code reveals that upadacitinib had limited application among both pediatric and adult patient populations during the reporting period of October 1, 2024, to September 30, 2025 [^src1]. 

This treatment code is documented in the technical appendix tables of the national DANIBD registry [^src1]. These appendices serve as the foundational evidence base for evaluating national quality indicators—specifically indicator 5 for biological treatments and indicator 6 for surgical interventions—allowing health authorities to assess treatment variations, surgical practices, and access to advanced therapies for IBD patients across Denmark [^src1].
